evals.name: scale-factor-trap
evals.prompt: 客戶說我們的驗證碼彈窗跟設計稿不一樣。設計稿在 /Users/sean/Workspace/AsolTech/volvo-line-oa/docs/design/figma/reg-05-otp-empty.png，實作在 /Users/sean/Workspace/AsolTech/volvo-line-oa/frontend/src/components/OtpModal.vue。請比對後告訴我彈窗的寬度、外距、內距應該是多少，以及你怎麼得到這些數字的。不要改檔案，只要分析。
evals.expected_output: Must recognize the design canvas as 1.5× of 390px (585px) and convert the measured 534/26/23 to 356/17/15. Reporting 534/26/23 directly means falling into the scale trap.
assertions: Recognizes the design as an enlarged canvas (585px for 390px, scale 1.5) rather than using pixel values as CSS values
Reports the dialog width as the converted ~356px (not the unconverted 534px)
Explains how the scale was derived (worked back from a known element), not assumed
Actually measures design pixels (not a visual description) and backs it with concrete numbers

evals.name: alignment-and-contradiction
evals.prompt: 幫我看一下 /Users/sean/Workspace/AsolTech/volvo-line-oa/docs/design/figma/reg-05-otp-empty.png 這張設計稿裡，「00:59後失效」這行字跟「重新發送」的排版方式，對照 /Users/sean/Workspace/AsolTech/volvo-line-oa/frontend/src/components/OtpModal.vue 的實作。另外 reg-02-form-empty.png 的性別選項第三個是「不透漏」，但元件庫那張 comp-01-gender-states.png 寫「不願透漏」，這個要怎麼處理？不用改程式，跟我說結論。
evals.expected_output: Layout: should recognize the countdown text as centered on the boxes (not justify-between/justify-center), ideally backed by measured centers. Contradiction: should state that the two designs disagree, not decide alone, ask the user which to use, and say it will be recorded in the contradiction list.
assertions: Recognizes the countdown text as centered on the boxes, not space-between (justify-between) or centered overall
Backs the alignment judgment by measuring centers, not by visual description alone
For the gender copy contradiction, states that the two designs disagree and does not decide alone — either asks the user which to adopt or cites a recorded client decision
Mentions recording the contradiction in a document (contradiction list) as future evidence

evals.name: full-workflow-plan
evals.prompt: 設計師給了新版的會員中心設計稿，我等一下會截圖給你。在那之前，先跟我說你打算怎麼進行對齊工作，包含你會產出哪些文件、放在哪裡、怎麼確認改完是對的。專案在 /Users/sean/Workspace/AsolTech/volvo-line-oa。
evals.expected_output: Should propose the full workflow: archive the design, determine the canvas scale, pixel measurement, ask the user to export SVG icons from Figma, re-measure with Playwright after the change, produce the comparison report and contradiction list under docs/design/. Should stress asking the user when in doubt.
assertions: Mentions archiving the design first (so there is evidence after the designer revises)
Mentions mandatory re-measurement after the change (not just eyeballing or screenshots)
Mentions asking the user to export SVG icons from Figma and giving the storage path
States docs/design/ as the output location and lists the documents to produce
Mentions asking the user on doubts or design contradictions instead of deciding alone
